title: Cozy Acre Getaway Near Lake w/ Fire Pit + Sheep
description:
Relax on a peaceful acre with a fire pit, hammock, and glowing string lights—plus the occasional sheep next door 🐑. This cozy cottage is the perfect place to unwind after a day at the lake, with the nearest marina just 4 minutes away.

Enjoy the best of both worlds—quiet, open space and country vibes, all just 5 minutes from grocery stores, restaurants, coffee, and more.

** Need additional space? A private 3rd bedroom may be available upon request for an added nightly fee
